thread:
Elaine: Quick sync — planning a retrospective for last week's infra incident. Thinking 45m to keep it focused. Two time options: Thu 11:00 or Fri 14:00. Who needs to be present? I propose: oncall, infra owners, eng leads, product. Agenda draft below, timeboxed.

Omar: Thu 11 works for me. :thumbsup:

Jia: I have a customer call Thu 11, prefer Fri 14.

Devon: I'm oncall Thu 11 (pager rota), so can't do Thu. Fri 14+1 for me.

Maria: Fri 14 is better. Can we add a short Customer Comms review (5m) to make sure we didn't miss anything?

Sam: Fri 14 ok. Also recommend we lock owners for open action items during the meeting.

Sasha: +1 for Fri 14. Request we keep the RCA deep-dive to 20m and action triage to 10m so we don't run over.

Elaine: Agree on Fri 14 and 45m total. New agenda suggestion:```
- 14:00-14:05 Quick check-in & context (Elaine)
- 14:05-14:20 Timeline + root cause summary (infra + oncall)
- 14:20-14:30 Action item review & owners (all)
- 14:30-14:35 Customer comms & external impact (Maria)
- 14:35-14:45 Wrap up: commitments & next steps (Elaine)
```

Omar: That looks tight but doable. Can we pre-share a 1-paragraph RCA snippet so people can read ahead?

Maria: I'll paste a short summary in the doc before EOD.

Devon: Also suggest we capture pager thresholds that triggered. Will add a couple logs to the doc.

Elaine: Cool. Final check — who is required (can't be optional): @Omar, @Devon, @Sasha, @Maria, engineering leads (Sam), and me. If anyone else thinks they must be in, flag it now.

Sam: OK, I'm in.

Jia: I can attend remote for the last 20m if helpful (can join after my call).

Elaine: Noted. I'll book for Fri 14:00-14:45 and set the meeting to 'required' for the list above, optional for others. Will include the pre-read link and the agenda.

calendar-bot: Meeting created: "Postmortem: infra incident" Fri 14:00-14:45 — attendees: Elaine, Omar, Devon, Sasha, Maria, Sam, Jia (optional). Location: Zoom / Conference-room-2. Agenda + pre-read attached.

Omar: Thanks — I'll quick-review the pre-read and flag any blockers before the meeting.

Sasha: If we need extra time, propose a follow-up working session next week rather than blowing out this slot.

Elaine: Agreed. If we can't close actions in 45m, we'll schedule a follow-up. Thanks everyone. :raised_hands:
